draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

I wanted to check in now that you've had Wrenfield for a week. Nothing's been set up yet, and that's completely fine — the first step is usually the hardest to find time for.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is the quickest way to see whether it fits how North Dynamics works. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
